# josebatista.dev

> A personal developer portfolio presented as an interactive Linux desktop, by José Batista.

josebatista.dev is a developer portfolio styled as a Linux operating-system desktop. It showcases the author's bio, software projects, and contact links, with a focus on development and observability. The site is built with VitePress and Vue 3 and uses a dark, terminal-inspired theme.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://josebatista.dev/): The interactive desktop entry point.
- [About](https://josebatista.dev/about/): Biography and background of José Batista.
- [Projects](https://josebatista.dev/projects/): Software projects with descriptions, languages, and star counts.
- [Contact](https://josebatista.dev/contact/): Links to reach the author.
